notes: Placed against your quotation 107/QTN262083 dated 21-10-2026, net QAR 8,200.00. Please acknowledge this order in writing and confirm stock availability and the collection date.

PAYMENT TERMS ARE NOT STATED ON YOUR QUOTATION, which reads only "AS PER TERMS". Kindly confirm your payment terms in writing with your acknowledgement of this order. No terms are agreed until you have done so.

PLEASE RAISE YOUR INVOICE AGAINST THIS ORDER AND IN THE NAME SHOWN ABOVE. Your quotation is addressed to Doha Cooling Trading & Solutions W.L.L.; this purchase is made by The New Doha Kitchen Equipment Services W.L.L., C.R. 199351, and the invoice is to be raised in that name, quoting LPO-211/2026.

SELECTION IS YOURS. The unit and the evaporator are selected by yourselves for a chiller room of 4.35 x 2.00 x 2.40 m (20.88 cbm) operating at 0 °C to +8 °C on R404A at a design ambient of 46 °C. Please confirm in writing that this selection carries that duty with the compressor running not more than sixteen (16) hours per day, and confirm that R404A is the refrigerant you recommend for this chiller duty rather than R134a or R449A.

ITEMS NOT ON THIS ORDER. This order covers the condensing unit and the evaporator only. The following are required to complete the installation and are not included: the refrigerant charge, the thermostatic expansion valve, filter drier and sight glass, the interconnecting copper tube and fittings, Armaflex insulation, the insulated condensate drain line, and the digital control panel. Please quote these separately, stating the refrigerant charge in kg for this system.

SPECIFICATION CONFIRMED AS ABOVE. The makes, models, part numbers and quantities stated are what we are ordering and what is to be supplied. Any substitution of make, model, capacity or refrigerant requires our prior written approval before collection; goods supplied against a substitution we have not approved are liable to be returned at your cost.

All items are to be supplied new, in original manufacturer's packing, with the manufacturer's data plate, warranty documentation, wiring details and the unit selection printout. We will inspect at collection and may reject on the spot. The prices are fixed and no handling, transport or other charge will be accepted beyond the total order value above.
